start.authority: Coordinating agent assigned new browser witnesses for the user-authorised isolated conformance repair; execution is separately scheduled.

graph.limitation: Graph predates ongoing web edits; actual current source governs selectors and request contracts.

start.invariant: Only the current authenticated view may paint protected results or select the next write target; partial input stays visibly partial and request success is not revocation confirmation.
population: empty and nonempty partial matter boards
late History list, History transcript, research and sessions responses after logout
start.proof_design: Use the real tools.served composition with encrypted temporary stores and scripted model/evidence. Establish matters by browser intake and send. Hold genuine served responses at the browser request boundary; verify a nonzero intercepted population, perform navigation/logout, then release. Mutate only declared partial-board fields and logout confirmation for adversarial controls. Record screenshots and request identity metadata on every case.
exclusions: No product/web changes by this worker
No existing journey manifest or registry edits
No real corpus, credentials, model/provider calls or remote resources
No pytest or gate execution by this worker

build.implementation: A separate journey-marked module reuses the existing real-product fixture and sign-in/intake/send helpers. Native Response.json observation identifies consumed bodies without changing their content. A pre-armed path-specific promise gate delays delivery of the original parsed object to the product while Python observes the genuine HTTP request and response; the browser waits for consumption plus rendering frames before judging absence. Every case writes a screenshot, HTML and request-identity metadata under .nm/conformance/browser; no cookies or credentials are recorded in request metadata.
build.boundary_controls: Requests and replies must have nonzero named populations. Two distinct matters are opened through served browser interactions; keyboard navigation waits for the exact selected transcript, even if display titles match. The unconfirmed-logout control confirms the actual session remains live, then retries genuine logout and confirms revocation.
build.limitations: No new Class-A static substitute was added: these promises require the real DOM. Tests are authored, not executed or proven. The coordinating agent owns any journey-manifest registration and approved run.

limitations: Two identity checks observed a changing tree; assertions retained for a frozen rerun.
Six delayed-response cases could not release a synchronously retained Route; unsupported harness lifetime, not a product conformance verdict.
prior_run.repair: Replaced retained Route objects with controlled native JSON-promise delay. Actual server requests, replies and values remain untouched. No rerun by this worker.

signoff.claim: This record does not assert browser conformance, acceptance PASS or completion.
